description: @lexical/history: which updates merge into one undo entry and which push a new one, undo, redo and clearing, and the CAN_UNDO/CAN_REDO notifications.

cases.name: typing merges within the delay and pushes after it, then undo and redo
a new edit after undo clears the redo stack
selection-only updates merge, and one that clears the selection is discarded
formatText, insertParagraph and a deletion, each undone
typing into an empty paragraph merges from the first character
paste and cut are their own entries
a composition that changes nothing merges
